title: ForeverYard — How Long Do Shrubs Take to Establish?

common.applies_to: General woody shrub (not rose-specific); establishment signals when planting date is unknown
common.preserved_uncertainty: Commercial gardening blog, not rose-specific, lowest reliability tier used in this ARC's source set.

content.identity: ForeverYard, Matthew Lewis, "How Long Do Shrubs Take to Establish?", 2 May 2025, https://foreveryard.com/how-long-do-shrubs-take-to-establish/, accessed during FRD-BUSHROSE-RECENTPLANT-02 research
content.relevance: Lists concrete observable establishment signs (new growth, healthy foliage, firm anchorage) and independently converges on a 2–3 year establishment timeframe, corroborating AF-1's restraint period from an unrelated, non-institutional source.
